description: This file defines the DataGroupService class which provides methods for accessing and manipulating data related to Data Groups and their permissions within the OrangeHRM system. It includes functionality for retrieving data groups, their permissions, and API permissions based on roles.

classes.name: DataGroupService
classes.description: A service class providing methods to access and modify data group permissions, retrieve data groups, and manage API permissions within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getDao
methods.description: Returns the DataGroupDao instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: setDao
methods.description: Sets the DataGroupDao instance to be used by this service.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermission
methods.description: Retrieves permissions for specified data groups, user role, and permission scope.

methods.name: getDataGroups
methods.description: Fetches all DataGroup entities in the system.

methods.name: getDataGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a DataGroup entity by its name.

methods.name: getApiPermissions
methods.description: Determines the API permissions for a given API class and roles.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissionCollection
methods.description: Builds a collection of data group permissions, merging permissions where necessary.
